hasAction.description: Decision D5: the meaning of the type (prefLabel, definition, subClassOf) is kept apart from the rest. The six-phase position moves from skos:broader to pp:phase (classification); profile, processDescription and provenanceClass move to a node of their own (pp:deployment); the openEO correspondences are grouped apart. The plan was already a node of its own.
serverSideFiles added: the raster input and output are names of files stored on the server (ZOO-Kernel dataPath), with no media type, each naming the Implementation Profile role it implements.

subClassOf changes from https://w3id.org/ogc/rim/activity-type/ActivityType to https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/activity-type/raster-reprojection, the activity type of the operation in bblocks-generic-profiles (decision of 2026-11-10), with the same entity type(s): http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature, http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature.

definition: The gdalwarp utility is an image mosaicing, reprojection and warping utility. The program can reproject to any supported projection, and can also apply GCPs stored with the image if the image is "raw" with control information.

serverSideFiles.name: InputDSN
serverSideFiles.location: A file name, relative to the directory set by `dataPath` in the `[main]` section of the ZOO-Kernel main.cfg of the server: the file is stored on the server, and the process reads or writes it there. Its format is the representation of the Implementation Profile role it implements (GeoTIFF for raster).

openeoEquivalence.rationale: Gdal_Warp exposes both `s_srs`/`t_srs` (CRS reprojection) and `r`/`te` (resampling method, target extent): a closer match to resample_spatial than W1's own `reproject-image` use of the same underlying tool (which only changes pixel size, `-t_srs` unused) -- here both the `projection` and `resolution`/`method` parameters of resample_spatial are exercised. Not exactMatch: GCP-based warping (`tps`, `rpc`, `geoloc`) and `order` (polynomial order) have no openEO equivalent.
